classificationDefinitions.canonical: Part of the intended clean-install schema history.
classificationDefinitions.historical: Retained because it is part of repository or Production history.
classificationDefinitions.superseded: Retained for history but replaced by a later reconciliation migration.
classificationDefinitions.reconciliation: Narrow forward-only correction for an observed deployed-state difference.
classificationDefinitions.manual: Represents a change known to have required manual Production handling.
classificationDefinitions.unknown: Production application state has not yet been verified.
